name: vector-hub
description: Generic multi-project vector retrieval library (built on Vectra) with a pluggable HTTP layer and a built-in visual console. Embed it into any project; the UI and AI agents share the same /api/search path.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }))"
